item.description:
Theme Squeeze 0.2.1

  • Choose High, Good or Smaller compression, compare videos, and export a JPEG preview with each MP4.
  • See video and photo thumbnails before squeezing.
  • Select several files with Command-click or Shift-click, or select the whole batch. Remove entries without deleting originals.
  • Moved or deleted sources show “File missing” with a Locate file action.
